description_en: Calls the Alibaba Cloud Elasticsearch Agent service based on the JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol. Supports creating and managing Agent sessions, sending messages and receiving SSE streaming responses, resuming from breakpoints, canceling in-progress tasks, and handling human-in-the-loop (HITL) interactions initiated by the Agent. Currently available only in the Shanghai region
description_zh: 基于 JSON-RPC 2.0 协议调用阿里云 Elasticsearch Agent 服务，支持创建和管理Agent会话、发送消息并接收SSE流式响应、断点重连、取消执行中的任务以及处理Agent发起的人工干预（HITL）交互。目前仅开放上海区域
name: InvokeEsAgent

parameters.help_en:
The request body in JSON-RPC 2.0 format.

Common request parameters (all at the top level of the request body, not inside params):
jsonrpc: String. Required. The JSON-RPC version. Fixed value: 2.0. Example: 2.0.
method: String. Required. The method to call. For valid values, see the method list below. Example: session/prompt.
id: String. Optional. The request ID specified by the caller. This value is passed through in the response. Example: 1774339902987004.
params: Object. Optional. The parameters for the specified method. For examples, refer to the supplementary description.
sessionCode: String. Optional. The session ID for exact match queries in session/list. Example: 49b82154-ac20-4f27-a6ec-eb5f4cfc5304.
pageNum: Integer. Optional. The page number for session/list. Default value is handled by the server. Example: 1.
pageSize: Integer. Optional. The number of entries per page for session/list. Default value is handled by the server. Example: 10.

Valid values of method:
session/new: Creates a session. Returns JSON.
session/list: Queries the session list or a specified session. Returns JSON.
session/prompt: Sends a message. Returns SSE.
session/load: Resumes from a breakpoint. Used only when _meta.isReload=true. Returns SSE.
session/cancel: Cancels in-progress tasks in a session. Returns JSON.
session/delete: Deletes a session. Returns JSON.
session/hitlRespond: Submits a HITL user response. Returns JSON.

Response modes: session/prompt and session/load return an SSE event stream with Content-Type text/event-stream. Each event is in the format data: {JSON}. Other methods return a standard JSON response with Content-Type application/json
parameters.help_zh:
JSON-RPC 2.0 格式的请求体。

统一请求参数（均位于请求体顶层，不在 params 内部）：
jsonrpc：String，必填。JSON-RPC 版本，固定为 2.0。示例值 2.0。
method：String，必填。调用方法，取值见下方 method 列表。示例值 session/prompt。
id：String，选填。调用方请求 ID，响应中会透传。示例值 1774339902987004。
params：Object，选填。method 对应参数。示例值可参考补充说明。
sessionCode：String，选填。session/list 按会话 ID 精确查询。示例值 49b82154-ac20-4f27-a6ec-eb5f4cfc5304。
pageNum：Integer，选填。session/list 页码，默认由服务端处理。示例值 1。
pageSize：Integer，选填。session/list 每页数量，默认由服务端处理。示例值 10。

method 取值：
session/new：创建会话，返回 JSON。
session/list：查询会话列表或指定会话，返回 JSON。
session/prompt：发送消息，返回 SSE。
session/load：断点重连，仅 _meta.isReload=true 时使用，返回 SSE。
session/cancel：取消会话下正在执行的任务，返回 JSON。
session/delete：删除会话，返回 JSON。
session/hitlRespond：提交 HITL 用户回答，返回 JSON。

响应模式：session/prompt 和 session/load 返回 Content-Type 为 text/event-stream 的 SSE 事件流，每条事件的格式为 data: {JSON}；其他 method 返回 Content-Type 为 application/json 的普通 JSON 响应
parameters.name: body

code.description_en: The status code. A value of 200 indicates a successful call. For non-200 values, the message field contains the error description
code.description_zh: 状态码。200 表示调用成功；非 200 时 message 字段包含具体的错误描述

additionalProperties.description_en: The values of each field in the JSON-RPC response body
additionalProperties.description_zh: JSON-RPC 响应体中各字段的值

data.description_en: The JSON-RPC 2.0 response body. data.result contains the actual return content of the called ACP method. data.id is the id passed in the request. data.jsonrpc is fixed to 2.0. data.timestamp is the UNIX timestamp in milliseconds when the response was generated
data.description_zh: JSON-RPC 2.0 响应体。data.result 承载所调用 ACP 方法的实际返回内容；data.id 为请求中传入的 id；data.jsonrpc 固定为 2.0；data.timestamp 为响应生成时间的 Unix 毫秒时间戳

message.description_en: The error description. The value is null when the call is successful. A specific error message is returned when the call fails
message.description_zh: 错误描述。调用成功时为 null；调用失败时返回具体的错误信息
message.example: Agent subscription is inactive or expired
